snippet.description:
Do you really need to follow five or six current-affairs sources for UPSC? AIR 56 Samiksha Dwivedi explains why you don’t. Learn how to connect newspaper articles with the UPSC syllabus, identify relevant topics for GS Paper 2 and GS Paper 3, and use monthly current-affairs magazines without overwhelming yourself. A practical approach to current affairs that focuses on relevance, revision and retention.
